future_before_after_policy: Before approved tests, record byte hashes, sizes and relative-path inventory of all regular files under both protected roots; reject symlink or unexpected path escape.
After approved tests, compare the complete inventories and hashes, and explicitly compare the two mandatory trace pins. Added, removed or changed protected files fail the isolation acceptance gate.
Check temporary output path is outside repository root before writing; test failure must not alter protected roots.
The current SHA values may serve as preservation pins from this point onward, never as proof of pre-r5c10l content.
